note: Aussies-in-the-majors — curated half of the hybrid. /api/aussies?league=mlb scans every ESPN active roster for birthPlace.country == Australia AND matches these names. ESPN MLB rosters are the 26-man active list, so injured/minor-league players simply don't render. Names must match ESPN fullName. Order = display priority.

players.name: Travis Bazzana
players.hook: The No. 1 overall pick — the first Australian ever taken first in the MLB draft, and the future of Cleveland's infield.

players.name: Liam Hendriks
players.hook: Three-time All-Star closer who beat cancer and came back to a big-league mound — the toughest man in the sport.

players.name: Curtis Mead
players.hook: The Adelaide kid who hit his way to Tampa Bay — a pure bat with a big-league future.

players.name: Jack O'Loughlin
players.hook: Left-hander from the Adelaide Giants who made it to the majors the long way.

players.name: Robert Perez Jr.
players.hook: Melbourne-born and Venezuelan-raised — Australia's newest big-league bat.
